# Keeping the commons

This essay is for the volunteers who look after the Hollins Lane meadow, and for anyone thinking of joining them.

## What the meadow is

The meadow is a strip of common land beside the orchard. It belongs to the parish, and the volunteers keep it.
Like the commons Elinor Ostrom studied, it lasts only while the people who use it agree on rules.

## How we decide

We meet on the first Sunday of each month and decide by consent, not by vote. We chose consent because a vote
leaves a losing side, and a small group cannot afford one.

This essay does not cover the orchard's finances; the treasurer reports on those.
